blurb: Guests visit Brigadoon's intimate tasting room with views over the vineyard and canyon. They can enjoy wine tastings, picnic in family-friendly terraced gardens, and experience local wildlife and serene natural settings. The winery produces organic wines from their 66-acre vineyard and offers artisan cheese and charcuterie boards to complement the wines.
